messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we need to finalize header-based negotiation for API v2 this week. High level: header 'X-RI-Api' to route old vs new semantics. Who's picking up proxy shim?
Sam: I can take the proxy shim. Plan: small sidecar that rewrites headers and forwards to v1/v2 backends. ETA: EOD Thurs for prototype.
Jon: I'll own the SDK bump to add explicit `ApiVersion` header helper and deprecate implicit behavior. Targeting a minor release Friday.
Liz: I'll coordinate canary slices and telemetry. Need list of routes + expected error modes so observability team can add quick traces.
Sam: Question — any non-backwards-compatible query params besides content-type? I ran a quick audit and found `stream-mode` differences.
Maya: Good catch — we should map `stream-mode=partial` -> header `X-RI-Stream: partial` in shim. Add to shim checklist.
Jon: SDK note: adding `ApiVersion` optional param. Example:
```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key, api_version='v2')
resp = client.text.generate(...)
```
Maya: Ops note: eng-infra needs to open a routing rule for slice 'beta-3' so shim can be tested there.
Liz: I'll ask infra now. @Sam is the shim going to set a cookie or only headers? cookies will be messy for multi-domain.
Sam: Headers only. We'll emit `X-RI-Compat: shim-v1-v2` for tracing.
deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded - service=api-proxy slice=beta-3 commit=ae12f4 :tada:
Maya: Risks: cache key changes — shim must preserve existing cache keys for v1 traffic. Add to checklist.
Jon: We'll add a `compat_cache` flag in SDK so apps can opt-in during rollout.
Liz: Milestones: prototype shim (Thu EOD), SDK minor release (Fri AM), canary tests (Fri PM), wide rollout next Tue if no regressions.
Sam: I'll post a short runbook in /docs once prototype ready.
Maya: Owners: Sam (proxy shim + runbook), Jon (SDK changes + release), Liz (canary + telemetry), Maya (release decision + comms).
Jon: Ping for code review — PR #4723 open. @Maya @Liz please review when you can.
Liz: Will review by noon tomorrow.
Maya: Thanks everyone. If infra routing isn't green by EOD ping me and I'll escalate.
Sam: noted.
deploy-bot: smoke check: api-proxy beta-3 latency +5ms p95, errors 0.1% (baseline 0.08%)
Maya: That's within expectations for canary. Liz, can you add alert for error-rate >0.5%?
Liz: Done, added alert to PagerDuty -> eng-oncall.
Sam: Prototype PR merged to feature branch, pushing canary now.
Jon: SDK PR opened for review: #872. Includes tests and migration notes.
Maya: Awesome. We'll reconvene async unless a blocker shows up. :shipit:
